name: FW-LAB Receiver
tagline: An RTL-SDR and GNU Radio ALERT receiver with MQTT output, a web UI with live audio and waterfall, and forensics tools.
about: The Flood Warning ALERT Base Station Receiver: a GNU Radio flowgraph that demodulates and decodes ALERT1 bursts from an RTL-SDR, logs them as CSV and JSONL, and publishes them over MQTT. A Python web UI shows events, RF health, trends, path analysis and forensics, and scripts and systemd units run it unattended on a Pi with a cloud control plane. It came before Flood-Net: Flood-Net has taken its floodwarning.net domain and has a runbook to retire it, and RPi ALERT now does its base-station job.

status.summary: Dormant since about May 2026 and being retired: Flood-Net took floodwarning.net from it, and RPi ALERT replaced it as the base-station receiver.
next: Copy, then archive the repository with a README line pointing to Flood-Net

blocked.what: Retirement steps in Flood-Net's runbook (docs/floodwarning-net.md) are owner dashboard actions

components.name: GNU Radio flowgraph
components.what: RTL-SDR (osmosdr) receive, FSK demodulation and symbol timing; one channel, default 173.9 MHz.

components.name: Decoder, logger and MQTT blocks
components.what: Python blocks: alert.decode.v1 events, CSV and JSONL logs, MQTT topics under alert/rx/.

components.name: Web UI
components.what: Dashboard, events, radio (waterfall and browser audio), data, path, stations, admin and forensics pages.

components.name: Install and operations
components.what: Installer, systemd units, auto-update timer, host monitor, log retention, soak and replay tools.

components.name: Control plane
components.what: Edge and control roles, S3 state and Cloudflare load-balancer failover on floodwarning.net hostnames.

provides.name: Receiver capabilities
provides.what: What the receiver runs on and what it publishes — cited by open-ALERT's catalogue.
